text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 1032 June 11, 1985
CREATING A COMMITTEE TO TAKE CHARGE OF THE PLANNING AND EXECUTION OF THE
COMMEMORATIVE ACTIVITIES FOR THE 1985 VICENTE ORESTES ROMUALDEZ CENTENNIAL
ANNIVERSARY
WHEREAS, 1985 marks the centennary of the birth of the late Vicente Orestes Romualdez, public servant,
lawyer, professor and educator;
WHEREAS, it is fitting and proper to commemorate the occasion with appropriate activities and/or
ceremonies; and
WHEREAS, to ensure the successful celebration of this event, there is a need to create a committee to take
charge of the planning and execution of the commemorative activities.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby constitute and create a committee to formulate plans and devise ways and
means for the successful execution of appropriate activities and/or ceremonies for the commemoration of the
1985 Vicente Orestes Romualdez Centennial Year. The committee shall be composed of the following:
1. Hon. Jaime C. Laya
Minister of Education, Culture & Sports
2. Chairman Francisco Tantuico
Commission on Audit
-- Co-Chairman
3. Dr. Serafin D. Quiason
Acting Chairman, National Historical
Institute & Director, The National Library
-- Vice-Chairman
4. Atty. Romualdo Mendiola
Vice President, Soloil, Tanauan, Leyte
5. Hon. Obdulia Cinco
Mayor of Tacloban
6. Hon. Cesar T. Palana
Mayor of Tolosa
7. Fr. Leonardo N. Mercado, SVD
President, Divine Word University, Tacloban
8. Ms. Ileana Maramag
SOSEC, Malacañang
9. Mr. Servillano de la Cruz
Regional Director, MECS, Region VIII
10. Mr. Pedro P. Gambalan
Officer-in-Charge, Bureau of Posts
11. Mr. Alfredo N. Salanga
c/o PANORAMA, Daily Bulletin Intramuros, Manila
12. Mr. Virgilio Almario
Secretary General, Philippine Board on Books
for Young People P.O. Box 10011, Quezon City
13. Atty. Victor Jose C. Veloso
Chapter President, Tacloban Integrated Bar
14. Mrs. Flordeliza K. Militante
Assistant Executive Director National Historical Institute
-- Member/Secretary
The Chairman is hereby empowered to request any agency of the Government to assist in the discharge of the
Committee's functions and duties to designate such personnel as he may require for the purpose.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-five.
